Not scoped to any one channel): NO em dashes or en dashes anywhere, in any field, ever — rewrite with commas, parentheses, or a period. No semicolons between independent clauses. No "simply", "just", "obviously", "actually", "leveraging", "delve". No "it's not X, it's Y" flips. No "Here's the thing:" / "The truth is:" preambles. - LINKEDIN LINK-IN-COMMENT: for LinkedIn channels, write a LINK-FREE post body (LinkedIn suppresses reach on posts with external links). Inline design/shane-personal-v2/tokens.css verbatim AND inline design/shane-personal-v2/fonts-embed.css (base64 brand webfonts) — do NOT rely on the Google Fonts <link>: the headless browser cannot fetch external fonts, so without the embedded file the render falls back to system fonts (off-brand).
